Description: Added shelly_devices table to store Shelly Plus Uni device registry with multi-tenant support
Technical Details: Columns: id, organization_id (FK), truck_id (FK), device_id (unique), device_name, device_model (default 'Plus Uni'), ip_address, firmware_version, last_seen_at, connection_status (default 'offline'), last_frequency, is_moving, movement_threshold (default 10), webhook_secret, is_active, created_at, updated_at. Indexes on organization_id, truck_id, device_id, and composite (organization_id, connection_status).
Acceptance Criteria: Tables created with proper foreign keys and indexes

Description: Added shelly_snapshots table to store latest readings for fast dashboard queries
Technical Details: Columns: id, organization_id (FK), shelly_device_id (FK), truck_id (FK), frequency, is_moving, temperature, voltage, rssi, recorded_at, updated_at. Unique index on shelly_device_id for upsert operations.

Summary: Implement storage interface for Shelly devices
Description: Added IStorage interface methods and DbStorage implementation for Shelly CRUD operations
Technical Details: Methods: getShellyDeviceByDeviceId(), updateShellyDeviceFromWebhook(), upsertShellySnapshot(), listAllShellyDevices(), markShellyDevicesOffline(). All methods follow existing multi-tenant patterns with organization_id filtering.
Acceptance Criteria: Storage layer consistent with PowerMon pattern

Description: POST /api/v1/shelly/vibration - Receives vibration data from Shelly devices
Technical Details: Query params: device_id (required), frequency (optional, default 0). Logic: Looks up device by device_id, updates last_seen_at and connection_status to 'online', calculates is_moving based on frequency >= movement_threshold (default 10 pulses/min), upserts snapshot record. Returns 200 OK with device state.
Acceptance Criteria: Webhook receives and processes Shelly data

Description: POST /api/v1/shelly/heartbeat - Maintains device online status without frequency update
Technical Details: Query params: device_id (required). Updates only last_seen_at and connection_status to 'online'. Used for keep-alive between vibration events.

Description: GET /api/v1/shelly/devices - Lists all active Shelly devices (admin only)
Technical Details: Secured with X-API-Key header requiring FLEET_API_KEY environment variable. Returns array of all active Shelly devices across all organizations for admin monitoring.
Acceptance Criteria: Endpoint secured with API key authentication

Description: POST /api/v1/shelly/check-offline - Marks stale devices as offline
Technical Details: Query params: threshold (optional, default 2 minutes). Secured with X-API-Key header. Finds devices with connection_status='online' and last_seen_at older than threshold, marks them as 'offline'. Returns count of devices marked offline.
Acceptance Criteria: Devices marked offline after 2+ minutes of no data

Description: SQL script for deploying Shelly tables to production via CloudShell
Technical Details: Creates shelly_devices and shelly_snapshots tables with all indexes. Run command: psql $DATABASE_URL -f migrations/shelly_devices_production.sql

Description: Defined truck movement state detection algorithm
Technical Details: Logic: Vibration frequency >= 10 pulses/min + Engine On (V > 13.8V) = Driving. Low frequency + Engine On = Idling. Low frequency + Engine Off (V <= 13.8V) = Parked. Threshold of 10 pulses/min is configurable per device via movement_threshold column.

Description: Setup instructions for configuring Shelly Plus Uni devices before deployment
Technical Details: Steps: 1) Connect to Shelly AP WiFi (ShellyPlusUni-XXXXXXXX). 2) Open 192.168.33.1 in browser. 3) Set device name to {TruckName}-Vibration. 4) Connect to truck router WiFi. 5) Configure input:2 as counter type. 6) Set webhook URL to https://app.deecell.com/api/v1/shelly/vibration?device_id=${info.id}&frequency=${status['input:2'].freq}
